title: What you bring
text: A short picture of your practical experience, what you want to own and what you want to develop. Three to five minutes. You can always add more later.

evidence.title: Tell us about something you recently pulled off yourself.
evidence.text: No CV, no cover letter. One concrete thing where you know: I did that. It can come from work, from your own project, from volunteering or from somewhere else entirely.
evidence.narrativePlaceholder: For example: I took our first enterprise customer from the first email to a signed contract – including the two rejections before that.
evidence.narrativeHint: At least {min} characters. Two or three sentences are plenty.
evidence.areaLabel: Which area does this belong to?
evidence.areaHint: Not a perfect fit? Pick the closest one – you can change it later.
evidence.levelLabel: How often have you done this?

areas.title: What else can you do?
areas.text: Start with the fields you have actually worked in. The concrete areas appear afterwards. Deliberately only the important ones – not everything you have touched once.

ownership.title: Which of these do you not want to own long term?
ownership.text: Being able to do something does not mean wanting to be responsible for it. Founders are rarely asked this question – and it settles a lot later on.
ownership.noEntries: You have not selected any areas yet.

levels.5: Applied in demanding situations too, can support others
